title: Expanding panels: Peak ticket
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: Readings are nonnegative. For each right endpoint, produce the shortest nonempty suffix ending there whose sum is at least k, or 0 when no such suffix exists. k is positive. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
A clerk slides a narrow inspection frame until its nonnegative readings meet the required total. Tomas is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Readings are nonnegative. For each right endpoint, produce the shortest nonempty suffix ending there whose sum is at least k, or 0 when no such suffix exists. k is positive.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement expandingPanelsPeakTicket(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Variable sliding windows. Readings are nonnegative. For each right endpoint, produce the shortest nonempty suffix ending there whose sum is at least k, or 0 when no such suffix exists. k is positive. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with variable sliding windows. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Readings are nonnegative. For each right endpoint, produce the shortest nonempty suffix ending there whose sum is at least k, or 0 when no such suffix exists. k is positive. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [1,1,1,2,1]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 2.
The derived sequence is [1,1,1,1]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 1.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
